children: SafePal will open the second season of its Solana gas-free trial in September.
The campaign will offer up to three gas-free transactions after the first season exhausted its allocation of 10,000 trials.
Gas free trials were gone in a flash, Season 2 is coming soon!
Are you ready to unlock up to 3 FREE gas transactions

SafePal is a cryptocurrency wallet that aims to provide a secure and user-friendly crypto asset management platform for the masses. SafePal provides hardware wallet and software wallet product lines, all paired and managed through the SafePal App, where users can easily store, manage, swap, trade, and grow their crypto wealth.
